summary: Platform in Wilson Hill WMA that the Forest Lookouts list says was built from parts of the Whites Hill tower; no second source found for that reuse.

access.note: On a state wildlife management area. Public use zones are open all year, but entry restrictions apply, and no source places this platform in a public use zone.

events.note: Built with parts of the Whites Hill tower, per the Forest Lookouts list. No year given.

notes_for_editor: The reuse of Whites Hill parts rests on one Forest Lookouts list entry. The NYSFLA Whites Hill entry and the Wikipedia article say nothing about reuse. No year, builder or condition is given for the platform. A search summary mentioned a birding hotspot titled 'Wilson Hill WMA--Hwy 131 tower' and a DEC map legend with an observation-tower symbol; neither was read, so it is unknown whether either refers to this platform. Whites Hill's record says 'gone', but its cabin survives at DEC's Trout Lake Shop (NYSFLA, Wikipedia); worth a human look. Access is unconfirmed; DEC Region 6 is the place to ask.
